facts.fact: NiMet says it completed installation of the PUMA 2025 / ClimSA Meteosat Third Generation satellite receiving station at its headquarters on 9 May 2025, replacing the earlier MSG 2015 station.

systems.tiers: headquarters station, internet access for airport forecast offices nationwide

note: No fact for forecast use, warnings or ISO 9001: the document only says the MTG data can be used for forecasting and that the system marks a new era for severe weather forecasting, not that NiMet issues forecasts or warnings from it.
